title: Iran's FM Araghchi arrives in Pakistan ahead of planned US ceasefire talks
summary: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived in the Pakistani ​capital Islamabad on Friday to discuss proposals for restarting peace talks with the United States, amid conflicting signals on whether he would meet with US negotiators there.
